chunks: From him, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from ʿĀṣim ibn Ḥumayd, from Muḥammad ibn Qays, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
ʿAlī عليه السلام ruled concerning the eye of a horse that was gouged out: one quarter of its price on the day the eye was gouged out.

key_terms.يَوْمَ: on the day when the valuation is considered

ai.seo_question: What is the compensation for gouging out the eye of a horse in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal ruling from Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام regarding injury done to an animal. It establishes financial liability for the loss of a horse’s eye as one quarter of its market value assessed on the day of the injury, reflecting principles of compensation and justice.
